name: whichquant
description: Check every GGUF quant in a Hugging Face repo against your GPU and RAM before downloading it, by reading only the file headers, and get the llama.cpp flags for each one.
compatibility: Prints llama.cpp flags for each quant, counts optional vision-projector and draft-model memory, and with -q prints llama-server and KoboldCpp commands including draft-model flags.
Pure Python 3.9+ standard-library CLI with zero runtime dependencies; reads local GGUF files or remote Hugging Face GGUF headers over HTTP range requests.
limitations: Weights are exact, but the compute buffer is an estimate and the KV cache follows llama.cpp's sizing rules; it estimates fit and does not run or benchmark the model.

Hardware tags are omitted because CI tests only CPU environments with explicit --gpu/--ram flags; auto-detection reads nvidia-smi on NVIDIA GPUs and macOS unified-memory defaults on Apple Silicon, while AMD and Intel users pass --gpu.
Checking a Hugging Face repo needs network access, and gated repos need HF_TOKEN; local GGUF files work offline.
Currently distributed as a Git source install (version 0.2.0 in pyproject.toml) with no tagged GitHub release or PyPI package yet.

sources.note: Usage, GGUF header inspection, vision and draft model sizing, llama-server and KoboldCpp output, accuracy notes, and Git source install.
CI test matrix covering Linux, macOS, and Windows on Python 3.9 and 3.13.
Hardware detection logic using nvidia-smi, macOS arm64 unified-memory defaults, and OS RAM queries.
